content.text:
I found 12 refund commits and looked up each order's amount from the orders capability. The amounts sum to 5959.80.

Orders: ORD-001, 003, 006, 008, 011, 013, 016, 018, 021, 023, 026, 028. I included all of them regardless of the order's status field, since the task defines refunds by commit subject. Three of them (008, 016, 028) show status "pending", so that is a judgment call if you meant only shipped orders.

<answer>5959.80</answer>
